healthcare_ops.synthesis: Former charge nurse, now consults on hospital operations. Writes plainly, uses concrete ward-level examples, skeptical of software-first fixes, warm but direct. Often ends with a practical question.

fractional_cfo.synthesis: Numbers-first, dry humor, short sentences. Talks about cash runway and close cycles from experience with small companies. Avoids hype; prefers one specific lesson per post.

saas_founder.synthesis: Founder voice: candid about mistakes, shares customer-discovery anecdotes, energetic but not salesy. Writes in first person with short paragraphs.

quality_lead.synthesis: Plain-spoken plant-floor manager. Uses shop examples (scrap bins, shift handovers), distrusts buzzwords, practical and a little blunt.

profile.industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

people_leader.synthesis: Empathetic and specific. Draws on stories from warehouse and driver teams, cares about frontline managers, avoids corporate jargon.
